1.why: Four distinct relation families (contrast/restatement/temporal/cause) give no tell; picked the cause option as the modal key type.

2.why: Four identical sentence frames differing only in friction numbers, so nothing but the digits varies; pure guess.

3.why: 'Instead' and 'Nevertheless' are the paired contrast options and 'In short' is the summary outlier; took the plain concessive.

4.why: All four are the same frame; 'vibration from passing heavy traffic' is the most emphasis-worthy predictor, the others are mundane.

5.why: 'To be sure' is a concession rarely keyed and 'Meanwhile' is a temporal filler; 'Consequently' is the strongest single-relation candidate.

6.why: Identical frames, only the throughput and rescan numbers change; chose the middle-high pair as a guess.

7.why: Addition/contrast/cause/example each appear once; 'For instance' is the family most often keyed when an example option is offered.

8.why: 'On the other hand' and 'Meanwhile' cluster as contrast-ish distractors; 'For example,' is the distinct illustrative option.

9.why: 'Instead' and 'Still' are both contrastive; picked the concessive 'Still' over the example and temporal fillers.

10.why: Emphasis needs the sharpest contrast: 52%-to-9% in the aerated pond against an untreated pond that ROSE 41 to 47; A and D have a flat or falling control.

11.why: Three contrast-family options (Instead/Meanwhile/Nevertheless) crowd each other, leaving 'In other words' as the lone restatement key.

12.why: The double limitation is strongest here - a biased time window ('Saturday mornings, the market's busiest period') plus counting passersby who may not have bought.

13.why: Surprise scales with the predicted-measured gap, and 26% vs 9% is the largest; its reason also directly explains dust not blocking light.

14.why: Caution needs an unresolved confound, and 'the raised beds sitting along a sunnier south wall' is uncontrolled, unlike D's one-off rainy June.

15.why: 'Regardless' and 'In that case' read as weak fillers; 'By comparison' fits the two-thing setup these sets usually build.

16.why: Addition/cause/specification/contrast one each; took 'However' as contrast is the commonest key when it stands alone.

17.why: 'Beforehand' is a near-nonsense distractor and 'Granted' a rare concession; 'As a result' is the plain causal key.

18.why: Addition appears twice (As a result aside, 'In particular' and 'Also' are elaborative), so the lone concessive 'Even so' stands out.

19.why: 'Even then', 'Regardless', 'If so' are all hedge-shaped distractors; 'In practice' is the one option that marks a real theory-vs-reality pivot.

20.why: Temporal/contrast/cause distractors surround one illustrative option, and 'For example' is the type most often keyed in that lineup.

21.why: 'By contrast' and 'Nevertheless' split the contrast family; chose the comparative one since these stems usually juxtapose two cases.

22.why: 'Instead' and 'Otherwise' are the replacement/conditional distractors; 'By contrast' is the clean juxtaposition key.

23.why: Likewise/Admittedly/For this reason are three different relations; 'Specifically' is the narrowing move these paragraphs most often need.

24.why: Example, intensifier and similarity all point the same direction; 'However' is the only reversal and so the likely key.
